schema.name: Do It Yourself LinkedIn Outreach Tool
schema.description: A self-serve LinkedIn outreach tool. Log in with your own LinkedIn account, build a campaign, upload your leads, and let it send connection requests and follow-ups on your behalf, with human-like sending behaviour and a full metrics dashboard.

hero.intro: Log in with your own LinkedIn account, build a campaign, upload your leads, and set your connection note and follow-ups. Our tool sends it all out with human-like behaviour, while your dashboard tracks every lead.

howItWorks.heading: Build a campaign, right here
howItWorks.intro: Click through the six steps. Every field actually works, this is exactly what your dashboard looks like.

steps.title: Connect Your LinkedIn
steps.description: Log in with your own LinkedIn account. It stays yours: the tool runs your outreach from your profile, nothing is handed over to us.

steps.title: Create a Campaign
steps.description: Start a new campaign for whichever list or segment you're targeting next. Every campaign runs independently, with its own leads, message, and schedule.

steps.title: Upload Your Leads
steps.description: Upload the list of leads you want to reach for this campaign.

steps.title: Write Your Connection Note
steps.description: Set the connection request note that goes out with your invite.

steps.title: Configure Your Follow-Ups
steps.description: Decide how many follow-up messages to send, what each one says, and the time delay before each one goes out.

steps.title: Launch the Campaign
steps.description: Hit launch. The tool mimics human behaviour to send out connection requests and follow-ups on your configured schedule.

features.heading: Everything you need to run it yourself

items.title: Runs On Your LinkedIn
items.description: You log in with your own account and stay in control of it. We don't manage or touch your profile, the tool just automates the sending.

items.title: Full Campaign Builder
items.description: Upload leads, write your connection note, and build a follow-up sequence, with as many campaigns running as you need.

items.title: Human-Like Sending
items.description: Connection requests and follow-ups go out mimicking human behaviour, on the schedule and delays you configure.

items.title: A Dashboard For Every Lead
items.description: See campaign-level and lifetime metrics, acceptance rate, reply rate, and the live status of every single lead.

dashboard.heading: See every campaign, every lead
dashboard.intro: Once a campaign is live, your dashboard tracks it in real time, at the campaign level and across your account.

metrics.title: Acceptance Rate
metrics.description: Per campaign and lifetime, across your account.

metrics.title: Reply Rate
metrics.description: How many of your accepted connections reply.

metrics.title: Lead Status
metrics.description: Where every single lead stands, at a glance.

deliverables.heading: Every campaign includes
items: A campaign builder for leads, connection notes, and follow-up sequences
Configurable number of follow-ups, message content, and time delay for each
Human-mimicking send behaviour for connection requests and follow-ups
A live dashboard with per-campaign metrics and lifetime metrics
Acceptance rate and reply rate tracking
Status tracking for every individual lead in every campaign

whoFor.heading: Built for people who'd rather run it themselves

items.title: Founders & Small Teams
items.description: Run your own LinkedIn outreach without hiring an agency or an SDR, from a dashboard built for exactly this job.

items.title: Sales Reps Who Want Control
items.description: Set up your own campaigns, write your own notes and follow-ups, and keep full visibility into every lead yourself.

items.title: Agencies & Consultants
items.description: Run outreach across your own or your clients' LinkedIn accounts, with a separate campaign and dashboard for each.

finalCta.intro: Book a demo and we'll walk you through building your first campaign.
finalCta.footnoteLead: Prefer we run it for you?
